body:
Retain a reproducible first-session latency baseline for website #748: fifteen successful live runs across five cold/warm/edited trials, exact task boundaries, individual values and independent statistics.

Cold click-to-result: 3.43–3.74s (median 3.55s); warm unchanged: 3.31–3.44s (median 3.41s); warm edited: 3.23–3.37s (median 3.31s). These are application-observed complete-result endpoints, including screen-text cadence, two animation-frame callbacks and canvas readback. Five samples on one unthrottled desktop do not establish learner tolerance, a performance budget or an isolated cache speedup.

Retain actual complete greeting/ROM reports, source and live asset identities, cache conditions, same-origin network response records, deployment metadata and three inspected canvas screenshots. Missing-result control fails without latency; empty, incomplete, stale, false-median and falsely fast evidence all reject. No positive sample was dropped.

Companion website verifier: code198x/website#751. Python evidence verification, independent statistics, Ruff check/format, Vale (zero findings), JS syntax/explicit-semicolon checks and git diff --check pass. No product change, new dependency, mobile/accessibility/CWV audit or learner effectiveness claim. Next is website #749; umbrella #124 stays open.
title: Retain first-session cold and warm latency evidence
